# httpQ

It is the unmodified installer from the httpQ project on SourceForge:
https://sourceforge.net/projects/httpq/files/httpq/v3.1/

[httpQ](https://httpq.sourceforge.net/faq.html) is not part of this tool and is not maintained by us. It is bundled
only so the remote works without hunting for a plugin last updated in 2003.
